### The engineering legs — RAN

  the `sig.acceptance-gate/1` evaluator (recorded inputs, never the
  wall clock) → run only when P34.46's `P34.46-slot` leg has left the
  RETURN PASS queue **and** `now ≥ 2026-10-14T14:00:00Z`; otherwise
  **exit 42** + a *suppressed* `sig.probe-run/1` record (the refusal is
  the evidence). The sweep itself is a read-only crawl of the five
  surfaces — sitemap/site URLs, API URLs, ranged-GET tile bytes, a
  downloaded `sig-public` listing, the repo tip via the P34.18
  count-only crawler — counting handle-list entries (never values) and
  the L3 §4.5/C6 not-claimable + status words outside the disclosed
  contexts (TS-10). Plus the F-02 absence probe (the cadence
  `http-absent` targets — one definition, no drift), the exit-item-5
  soak leg (skipped until P34.46's L3 read is recorded), and a
  `--reads-file` slot for the caller-captured scheduler/billing/cert
  reads. Overall: `pass` only when every leg ran clean; `skipped`/`partial`
  legs make `partial`, never `pass`.
- `docs/build/tools/acceptance_report.py` (`generate`/`check`): the

- `docs/build/tools/gate_packet.py` (`draft`/`check`): the GATE-G4

### Deviation notes

- **Size budget (S ≤1,500 → ~2.6k excl. generated/fixtures).** Over
  budget, recorded (the P34.45 ~2.0k/S and P34.43/44a/44b M-budget
  precedents). The mass is three load-bearing pieces — the sweep +
  gate (`acceptance.py`, ~840), the per-row layer/exit-item evaluator
  (`acceptance_report.py`, ~826), the packet drafter
  (`gate_packet.py`, ~260) — plus their tests (~660). A split would
  separate the sweep from the note/packet that exist to read its
  record; the ticket is the one capstone row that owns all three.
- **Suppressed record committed mid-run** (`11A-probe-run.json`) so the
  refusal is committed evidence; it regenerates at the live leg.

- **Stale projection on `9f069aaf`:** the run-ledger + PR-body record
  commit drifted `reports/current/` (the P34.46 convention —
  record commits regenerate the projection) — regenerated at
  `9975d984` (verify: 1002/1002 input digests).
- **Future-dated literals on `9975d984`:** the B4 R5 sweep flagged the
  `WINDOW_EARLIEST` constant (its marker lacked the second colon) and
  seven synthetic test instants — all eight marked
  `future-ok: scheduled:`/`future-ok: synthetic:` at `b3397661`; the
  checker sweep is green again.
